tasks.title: Design LangGraph Core Architecture
tasks.description: Enhance and unify the existing LangGraph architecture to serve as the unified backend orchestration engine for the SpaceLive platform, building upon the current implementation.
tasks.details:
Enhance the existing LangGraph architecture in `/prototype/backend/services/ai/dialogue_graph.py` and related modules to create a unified orchestration system with the following improvements:

1. Complete the ongoing modularization refactoring:
   - Finalize migration from `services/ai/` to specialized modules like `services/dialogue_manager/`
   - Ensure clean interfaces between modules

2. Enhance and standardize core node types:
   - Integrate existing nodes from `/prototype/backend/services/ai/graph_nodes/`
   - Extend with additional required nodes:
     - `TimeTriggerNode`: For schedule-based triggers
     - `StateMonitorNode`: For monitoring character state and idle time
     - `UserInputNode`: For processing user inputs
     - `SchedulerNode`: For managing scheduled tasks
     - `LLMInterfaceNode`: For LLM API calls (enhance existing)
     - `MemorySystemInterfaceNode`: For memory read/write operations (enhance existing)
     - `EmotionAnalyzerNode`: For analyzing text emotions

3. Unify flow differentiation:
   - Implement simplified path for real-time dialogue
   - Implement complex path for scheduled tasks with tool invocation
   - Enhance existing murmur_service for spontaneous dialogue flow

4. Improve state management:
   - Design shared state structure for all behavior types
   - Implement robust state persistence mechanism
   - Ensure state sharing across different flow types

Build upon the existing Python with FastAPI backend framework. Ensure the architecture remains modular and extensible to accommodate future tools and functionalities. Focus on iterative development with functional milestones at each stage.
tasks.testStrategy:
1. Manual testing of each component as it's developed
2. Integration verification when connecting components
3. Basic functionality validation for each milestone
4. Performance checks to ensure response times meet requirements (<1.5s for real-time dialogue, <3s for scheduled tasks)
5. Use simple mocks for external dependencies during development

tasks.title: Implement Three-Layer Memory System
tasks.description: Develop the three-layer memory architecture for the virtual character, including short-term, medium-term, and long-term memory components using an MVP approach with incremental milestones.
tasks.details:
Design and implement a comprehensive memory system with three distinct layers using an incremental MVP approach:

**Milestone 1: Basic Short-term Memory**
- Implement storage and retrieval of recent events
- Daily emotion fluctuations
- Event summaries
- Task photos
- Utilize existing database structures and interfaces
- Integrate with LangGraph through the `MemorySystemInterfaceNode`
- Focus on basic functionality that works end-to-end

**Milestone 2: Simplified Medium-term Memory**
- Weekly selection of high emotional value events
- Formation of main storyline events
- Implement using simple selection criteria initially
- Build upon the short-term memory integration

**Milestone 3: Basic Long-term Memory**
- Implement chronological memory storage
- Audience quote wall
- Simple autobiographical trajectory
- Focus on reliable storage and basic retrieval

**Implementation Strategy:**
- Prioritize using existing database structures and interfaces
- Start with simple memory storage and retrieval functions
- Iterate to add more complex filtering and prioritization algorithms later
- Ensure each milestone delivers working functionality
- Prioritize early integration of short-term memory with LangGraph framework

tasks.title: Develop Unified Trigger Mechanism in LangGraph
tasks.description: Implement the unified trigger system within LangGraph to handle time-based scheduling, state monitoring, and user input processing, following an MVP development approach with incremental milestones.
tasks.details:
Create a comprehensive trigger system within LangGraph that unifies all behavior initiation, focusing on incremental development with clear milestones:

1. Milestone 1: Time Trigger Implementation
   - Develop basic `TimeTriggerNode` that monitors system time
   - Implement scheduling logic based on the six broadcast periods defined in the PRD
   - Leverage existing codebase time handling and scheduling functionality
   - Prioritize integration with LangGraph framework for basic scheduled tasks
   - Ensure working demonstration of time-based triggers

2. Milestone 2: User Input Handler
   - Develop basic `UserInputNode` for processing real-time user messages
   - Implement simple input classification to route to appropriate processing paths
   - Create functional demonstration of user input triggering system responses
   - Ensure proper connection with WebSocket communication layer

3. Milestone 3: State Monitor Implementation
   - Develop basic `StateMonitorNode` that tracks character state
   - Implement idle time detection to trigger spontaneous dialogue
   - Create simple demonstration of state-based triggers

4. Future Enhancements (Post-MVP):
   - Implement priority system for handling competing triggers
   - Develop state machine to manage transitions between different triggered states
   - Create logging system for trigger events for debugging and analysis
   - Enhance time triggers with special dates or anniversaries detection
   - Expand state monitoring with emotional thresholds and interaction pattern tracking

Focus on delivering working functionality at each milestone before moving to the next phase. Ensure all triggers are properly integrated with the WebSocket communication layer for real-time updates to the frontend.

tasks.title: Implement Scheduler Node and Broadcast Period Logic
tasks.description: Develop the SchedulerNode component in LangGraph to manage the six daily broadcast periods with their specific content and tool combinations, following an MVP development approach.
tasks.details:
Implement the `SchedulerNode` in LangGraph using an incremental MVP approach with the following milestones:

**Milestone 1: Basic Scheduler Implementation**
- Create a minimal SchedulerNode that can manage simple scheduling tasks
- Extract and reuse relevant functionality from existing murmur_service and dialogue_manager
- Implement basic scheduling capabilities with time-based execution
- Focus on core functionality without complex tool orchestration

**Milestone 2: First Broadcast Period Implementation**
- Fully implement the Space Morning Report broadcast period
- Create the configuration schema for defining this initial period
- Implement basic content generation for this period
- Ensure integration with Task 3 (Trigger Mechanism) for time-based execution

**Milestone 3: Incremental Period Addition**
- Gradually implement remaining broadcast periods one by one
- Expand the configuration system to handle additional periods
- Add period-specific tool selection as needed for each new period
- Develop content coordination capabilities incrementally

**Core Implementation Components:**
1. Period Configuration System:
   - Start with simplified configuration for initial periods
   - Expand configuration schema as more periods are added

2. Period-Specific Tool Orchestration:
   - Begin with basic tool selection for first period
   - Add complexity as more periods are implemented

3. Content Generation Coordination:
   - Focus on generating appropriate content for each implemented period
   - Build transition handling incrementally

4. Schedule Execution Engine:
   - Implement basic timing control that integrates with the trigger system
   - Add more sophisticated features in later iterations

Prioritize integration with Task 3 to ensure the system can execute basic broadcast tasks based on time triggers.

   - Create basic emotional memory integration with Memory System

**Milestone 3: Basic Appearance Changes**
3. Emotion Expression:
   - Implement basic expression mapping to 3D model controls

   - Develop limited gesture selection based on emotions

4. Emotion-Driven Appearance Evolution:

   - Implement basic visual changes triggered by emotional thresholds
   - Create minimal mapping between emotion types and visual effects

Ensure basic integration with the LangGraph Core (Task 1) and Memory System (Task 2) at each milestone, focusing on having functional features at each stage.

tasks.title: Develop Tool Nodes for Content Generation and External Services

tasks.details:
Create a set of tool nodes within LangGraph using an incremental MVP development approach:

**Milestone 1: Core Content Generation (MVP)**
- Implement `StoryGenerationNode` for simple sci-fi stories
- Create `GreetingGenerationNode` for basic opening rituals
- Focus on minimal viable functionality with simple prompts
- Ensure integration with LangGraph core (Task 1)

**Milestone 2: Basic External Services**
- Implement `NewsFetchingTool` for space and science news using a simple reliable API
- Create `WeatherRetrievalTool` with minimal functionality
- Develop `ImageDisplayNode` for showing content
- Integrate with scheduling nodes (Task 4) to enable basic broadcast functionality

**Milestone 3: Expanded Functionality**
- Add `DiaryGenerationNode` for AI diary entries
- Implement `AIImageGenerationTool` for simple image generation
- Create `MusicPlaybackTool` for theme songs
- Develop additional tools based on priority needs

**Implementation Guidelines:**
- Use simple, reliable APIs and services
- Implement minimal feature set for each tool node
- Ensure each milestone delivers demonstrable functionality
- Prioritize integration with core system over complex features
- Defer complex error handling and fallback mechanisms
- Focus on functional implementation rather than extensive testing

Ensure close coordination with Task 1 (LangGraph Core) and Task 4 (Scheduling Nodes) to guarantee tool nodes can be properly utilized within broadcast periods.

tasks.title: Implement System Integration, Testing and Deployment
tasks.description: Integrate core components, conduct basic testing, and prepare the MVP system for lightweight deployment and initial operation.
tasks.details:
Perform essential system integration and prepare for MVP deployment using an iterative approach:

1. Milestone 1: Basic Component Integration
   - Ensure core LangGraph nodes work together correctly
   - Verify basic frontend-backend communication
   - Test essential tool integrations under realistic conditions
   - Focus on integrating only critical components for MVP functionality

2. Milestone 2: Basic Deployment Preparation
   - Create simple containerization with Docker
   - Implement basic deployment process (manual or simplified automation)
   - Set up minimal production environment
   - Prepare basic backup procedures

3. Milestone 3: Simplified System Monitoring and Maintenance
   - Implement basic error logging
   - Set up essential system monitoring
   - Create simple restart and recovery procedures
   - Establish basic maintenance routines

4. Simplified Performance Considerations:
   - Focus on system availability rather than perfect performance
   - Identify critical performance bottlenecks only
   - Implement basic optimizations where necessary

5. Essential Documentation:
   - Document core system architecture
   - Create basic operational procedures
   - Document known limitations and future improvement areas

6. MVP Launch Planning:
   - Develop simple rollout strategy
   - Create basic contingency plans
   - Prepare for rapid feedback collection and iteration

Prioritize getting a working system deployed quickly to gather real-world feedback, with the understanding that improvements will be made iteratively in future versions.
